why_new: The c010-r6 pre-prepare argcheck had no c010 receipts. main now carries accept/c010-r6/receipts/*, whose recorded linker rewrites add 12 rewrite-attributed sites (46 -> 58). One of them, func_001b48c8 +60, attributes an erased call to func_00215ec4 and exposes the two facts.

observations: accept/c010-r6/receipts/c010-r6-{a,b}.json record two inline_nop rewrites in func_001b48c8. +52 (site 0x001b48fc) has removed_callee register_sound_resource_cache_cleanup (section i.register_sound_resource_cache_cleanup, 4 B, src/models/object_registration/sound_resource_cache.c) and target null. +60 (site 0x001b4904) has target 0x00215ec4.

argcheck attributes only the +60 site (kind linker_rewrite, callee func_00215ec4). Because the +52 site has no target identity, it is not modelled as a call, so its argument writes are not consumed or reset.

The r1/r2 writes at 0x001b48f8/0x001b48f4 precede the +52 registration site. They are the second and third arguments of source line 12, register_sound_resource_cache_cleanup(cache, func_001b501c, func_00100000); r0 already holds cache from func_001b4f58. Only the r0 write at 0x001b4900 belongs to the +60 call, source line 14: func_00215ec4(&data_0023ecec).
func_00215ec4 is the empty one-pointer guard release (src/wave4/func_00215ec4.c). It is accepted since wave4, and both declarations agree on void(volatile unsigned int *).
adjudication.qualification: [INFERENCE] Attribution of the r1/r2 writes to the +52 removed-callee site comes from site order plus the receipt-recorded removed callee and the caller source's three-argument registration call. The erased registration identity itself stays unrecovered, as already recorded in the c010 known issues.
